subject.title: [Feature]: Memory/Context Improvements (metrics + global semantic search + conversation chaining + preload on restart)

question: Should this broad memory/context umbrella stay open as one product-design tracker, or should maintainers split it into separate metrics, session-continuity, semantic-recall, and restart-preload issues?
rationale: The remaining work changes product/API surface, privacy boundaries, config/default behavior, and gateway lifecycle semantics; source inspection shows partial adjacent implementation but no single narrow code fix can choose those policies safely.

options.title: Keep Umbrella, Design First
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical umbrella and require maintainer design before any implementation PR changes defaults or exposes new metrics/recall APIs.

options.title: Split Into Scoped Issues
options.body: Close or convert this umbrella only after creating narrower canonical issues for metrics, session chaining, recall scope, and restart preload with explicit security acceptance criteria.

options.title: Defer Remaining Work
options.body: Mark the remaining behavior as not planned for now and point users at existing opt-in memorySearch/sessionMemory/startupContext/BOOT.md surfaces.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella, Design First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical umbrella and require maintainer design before any implementation PR changes defaults or exposes new metrics/recall APIs.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior issue discussion and git history show Peter Steinberger already reviewed this umbrella and introduced the experimental session-memory surface central to the decision.
